text:
maria: Heads-up — RFC posted for rerank deprecation. Quick async check: any objections to adding an optional params.deprecation_mode enum (warn | emulate | force) to help migrate clients?
chris: what exactly would each mode do? will it change ordering by default? :thinking_face: 
maria: short: warn = server keeps legacy ordering but includes warnings in meta; emulate = server computes new ordering but also returns legacy ordering for verification; force = server returns only the new ordering. This lets clients opt in before we change the default.
devon: we must keep old clients safe. default should be legacy if param not present.
maria: agreed — default=legacy for now. we'll only flip default after we see broad opt-in and a deprecation window.
sasha: we should address NaN/null score behavior — v1 bugs were caused by that.
maria: plan: treat null scores as lowest (sent to end). Normalize NaN -> null. Add results[*].score_present boolean so consumers can differentiate missing vs zero.
product-june: should we add a top-level meta.warnings array so frontends can display migration messages?
maria: yes. meta.warnings as array of strings. e.g. meta: { "warnings": ["rerank_v1 deprecated, send deprecation_mode=emulate"] }
chris: tie-breaker: current system is nondeterministic across replicas which breaks tests.
maria: propose stable deterministic fallback: primary sort by score desc, secondary sort by hash(candidate_id + model_version). That ensures stable order across replicas and versions.
devon: this will change order for exact-equal-score cases; that's expected and why emulate exists.
sasha: confirm: hash-based tie-breaker is deterministic given same inputs. good.
apitools-bot: deploy-plan: feature-flag rerank_rfc_deprecation -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% after 48h checks.
maria: sample request shape (new optional params):
```json
{
  "queries": [{"id":"q1","text":"find policies"}],
  "candidates": [{"id":"c1","text":"policy 1"}, {"id":"c2","text":"policy 2"}],
  "params": {"deprecation_mode":"emulate", "tie_break_seed":"optional-override", "score_epsilon":1e-6}
}
```
chris: tie_break_seed is useful for deterministic replay in tests.
maria: yes. if tie_break_seed present use it as salt; otherwise use model_version as salt.
sasha: emulate mode example response:
```json
{
  "results": [{"query_id":"q1","ranked":["c2","c1"], "legacy_ranking": ["c1","c2"]}],
  "meta": {"warnings": ["rerank_v1 deprecated"], "deprecation_mode":"emulate"}
}
```
product-june: where do compatibility tests live? contract tests vs E2E?
devon: both. contract tests assert presence/shape of legacy fields and emulate behavior. E2E for perf/regression checks.
chris: scores — are we normalizing to a fixed range?
maria: not now. keep score as opaque float. add optional results[*].score_confidence in [0,1] for model certainty; additive and backward compatible.
sasha: clarifying sorting: we will treat equality as exact float equality unless client supplies params.score_epsilon. If score_epsilon set, comparator treats |a-b| <= epsilon as equal.
maria: we'll document recommended epsilon 1e-6. default unset.
apitools-bot: contract checklist: params.deprecation_mode (optional string), params.tie_break_seed (optional string), params.score_epsilon (optional float), meta.warnings (optional array), results[*].legacy_ranking (optional array), results[*].score_confidence (optional float), results[*].score_present (optional bool).
devon: backwards compatibility checklist:
- new optional fields must be ignored by old clients (OK)
- default remains legacy if param absent (OK)
- emulate must include legacy_ranking for tests (OK)
- force gated behind feature-flag rollout (OK)
- update SDKs to parse meta.warnings (TODO)

maria: rollout timeline proposal: week0 canary 5% emulate; week2 public announce + SDK patch; week4 25% emulate; week8 opt-in pushers; week12 flip default for dev/test customers; week20 force behind enterprise gates; remove legacy mode after ~1 year.
product-june: add migration guide + blog post.
chris: PR review ping — I left comments about NaN tests and emulate contract tests.
maria: @chris @devon can you review by EOD? I'll add comparator pseudo-code to RFC.
chris: on it.
devon: will do tests tomorrow morning.
sasha: log deprecation_mode and client_version in request logs for auditing please.
maria: telemetry ticket created.
apitools-bot: deploy-note: canary created for feature flag rerank_rfc_deprecation at 5% in west01. Monitoring alarms: latency > 10% and error_rate > 0.1%.
chris: no blocker from my side.
product-june: product approves async.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll update RFC and post a short summary to #product.
apitools-bot: thread closed by maria
